packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and digest updates once CI passes

Auto-merge minor updates too, but only where the default branch carries a required status check set, so that `green` means a named check actually ran and passed rather than that nothing ran. Every repository listed here was confirmed on 2026-09-22 to carry a `required_status_checks` rule with a non-empty context list on its default branch; `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/{branch}` answers it. The list is explicit rather than estate-wide because the other repositories extending this preset have no ruleset at all: tobias-dev/bq-video and the beliq-eu connectors report `mergeable_state: clean` with nothing enforcing it, which is the state an auto-merge rule must never read as a pass. tobias-dev/bq-beta qualifies on its ruleset but does not extend this preset at all, so it is absent here rather than excluded. Re-check the list against the rulesets before adding a repository to it. Reasoning and the dry run that sized it: beliq-hq/TRIAGE-CAPACITY-ROADMAP.md pass 1 item 3.
